chunks: ʿAlī narrated from his father, from al-Nawfalī, from al-Sakūnī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام said: “Regarding the thief, if he is apprehended after having taken the goods while he is still inside the house and has not yet gone out, he said: there is no hand-cutting upon him until he takes it out of the house.”

key_terms.الدَّارِ: the residence or property from which the stolen goods must be removed
key_terms.السَّارِقِ: the thief, the person accused of committing theft
key_terms.الْبَيْتِ: the house in which the property was taken
key_terms.قَطْعٌ: the legal punishment of hand-cutting in the hadd of theft

ai.seo_question: When is the hadd punishment for theft applied in Islam according to Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning theft and the application of the hadd punishment. It states that the hadd of hand-cutting is not carried out merely by taking property inside the house; rather, the thief must have removed it from the house for the ruling to apply.
